observations: A rounded, seed-shaped form sits atop a slender upright body rendered in layered ochre and olive tones, with a dark reddish-brown shadow cast behind it against a deep crimson field.
Two horizontal bands of tight blue-outlined zigzag lines cross the figure — one at face level, one at the midsection — with red marks visible inside each band.
One arm extends outward ending in a curved, hook-like appendage; the opposite side shows no visible arm, giving the silhouette an asymmetric, off-balance quality.
reading: A compact figure leans slightly forward, its oval head unbroken by any readable feature except two zigzag bands — one where eyes might be, one cinching the midsection. The deep crimson ground presses close, and a shadow doubles the form without clarifying it. The hooked limb and absent arm tip the stance toward something between a bow and a stumble — readable as ceremony, submission, or simple imbalance.
